posture_checks.fix: Publish a v=spf1 record ending in -all.

posture_checks.label: More than one SPF record
posture_checks.help: Two or more TXT records begin v=spf1. Receivers treat this as a permanent error.

posture_checks.label: SPF over the lookup limit
posture_checks.help: The record and its includes need more than 10 DNS lookups. Receivers treat this as a permanent error.
posture_checks.fix: Flatten includes or remove unused mechanisms.

posture_checks.label: No DMARC record
posture_checks.help: No TXT record beginning v=DMARC1 at _dmarc.

posture_checks.label: DMARC policy is none
posture_checks.help: p=none. Failing mail is delivered and only reported.
posture_checks.fix: Raise p to quarantine, then reject.

posture_checks.label: DMARC leaves subdomains open
posture_checks.help: sp=none while p is quarantine or reject.
posture_checks.applies: Every zone with an enforcing DMARC policy.
posture_checks.fix: Remove sp or set it to reject.

posture_checks.label: DKIM key under 1024 bits
posture_checks.applies: Every zone with a readable RSA DKIM key.

posture_checks.label: DNSSEC validation fails
posture_checks.help: A validating resolver answers SERVFAIL while a plain query answers.
posture_checks.fix: Check the DS record and the zone's signatures.

posture_checks.label: SPF does not fail unknown senders
posture_checks.help: The SPF record ends in ~all or ?all, or has no all mechanism.
posture_checks.fix: End the record with -all once every sender is listed.

posture_checks.label: DMARC applies to a share of mail
posture_checks.applies: Every zone with an enforcing DMARC policy.
posture_checks.fix: Remove pct or set it to 100.

posture_checks.label: DMARC without reporting
posture_checks.help: The record names no rua address.

posture_checks.label: No DKIM selector answered
posture_checks.help: None of the probed selectors returned a key. Selectors outside the list are not checked.
posture_checks.fix: Publish the DKIM key the mail provider issued.

posture_checks.label: No MTA-STS policy
posture_checks.fix: Publish _mta-sts and serve the policy at mta-sts.<zone>.

posture_checks.label: MTA-STS not enforcing
posture_checks.help: The policy mode is testing or none, or the policy file did not load.
posture_checks.applies: Every zone with an MTA-STS record.
posture_checks.fix: Set mode: enforce in the policy file.

posture_checks.label: Zone not signed
posture_checks.help: No DS record at the parent and no validated answer.
posture_checks.fix: Sign the zone and publish the DS record at the registrar.

posture_checks.label: No CAA record
posture_checks.help: Any certificate authority may issue for the zone.
posture_checks.fix: Publish CAA records naming the authorities in use.
